headAtLaunch.source: Git reflog chronology, not contemporaneous launch receipt; original launcher omitted Git HEAD

initialStageAttempt: Aborted on HEAD assertion before git add; no index mutation
ownership: Current explicit phase assignment owns the complete Git transaction. Only current technical CLI is present; all other Forest CLI commands explicitly forbid Git. Completed intervening commit is disjoint protected asset content. Preserve it and use its HEAD as parent; no reset/amend/rewrite or asset staging.
boundary: Writer of the completed commit is not identified by Git metadata. Its final tree is preserved. Check full index, exact intended files and unchanged HEAD again immediately before commit.
regression: Future launch receipt must record current actual HEAD alongside immutable binary/helper hashes; preparation HEAD alone is not launch provenance.
